people.name: Abishag
people.line: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David

people.name: Adonijah
people.line: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne

people.name: Shunammites
people.line: People from Shunem; includes Abishag and the Shunammite woman

translations.web: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”
translations.bsb: So Bathsheba said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your brother Adonijah as his wife.”
translations.kjv: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
translations.asv: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
